title: zazzle-csharp-indexer code-question use case
description: How a coding agent's question about C# structure, asked of zazzle, reaches the indexer's live index and comes back.

entities.name: Answer a question about the code's structure
entities.description: A coding agent asks zazzle (zazzle_overview, zazzle_find_symbol, zazzle_changed_since, zazzle_git_log, zazzle_git_blame, or zazzle_read of a .cs file), and zazzled gets the answer from zazzle-csharp-indexer's daemon.
entities.goal: Get a compact, current answer about the code in its work tree, such as its structure, where a symbol is declared, what changed or who changed a line.
preconditions: The agent's MCP client starts zazzled mcp (zazzle-csharp-indexer init registers it), or the agent runs the zazzle command.
zazzle-csharp-indexer is $ZAZZLE_INDEXER, beside zazzled or on PATH.
The working directory is inside a git work tree, and git is on PATH.
postconditions: The agent has the answer as text, with paths relative to its working directory, or an error it can act on.
The call is in the indexer's usage log, with how the answer was produced.

flow.action: Calls a zazzle structure tool, for example zazzle_find_symbol with a name, or runs zazzle find-symbol NAME.
Finds the git work tree that holds the working directory and the indexer executable, and turns any path argument into one relative to the work tree.
Connects to the daemon socket in the indexer's state directory, starting zazzle-csharp-indexer daemon when nothing answers, and sends the indexer's version and the work tree as the root.
Checks the root is inside a git work tree and attaches its index, starting the watcher and the initial reconcile the first time the root is seen; replies ok.

Runs the named internal tool (overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame or view), which waits for the index when it needs it and answers from the index, git or the file, and logs the call.
Rewrites root:path references as paths relative to the working directory, cuts the text to its budget and tags it for the session.
Reads what it found with zazzle_read, pages on with offset, or says what it could not get with zazzle_report_gap.

alternatives.condition: The working directory is not inside a git work tree, or the indexer is not installed.
alternatives.outcome: zazzle answers with an error saying so.

alternatives.condition: The daemon runs another version and has no other clients.
alternatives.outcome: It stops; zazzled starts a new one and tries again (three attempts in all).

alternatives.condition: No daemon starts within five seconds.
alternatives.outcome: zazzle answers "the indexer daemon did not start".

alternatives.condition: The index is still building after the 30-second ready timeout.
alternatives.outcome: overview and find_symbol return index_cold, pointing at zazzle_ls and zazzle_find.

alternatives.condition: The tool fails (bad arguments, unknown root, git error, a file that is not C#).
alternatives.outcome: The agent gets an error with the message; the log records the error code.
